name: write_offset_byte_triplet
description: Takes a 16-bit value in D1 and writes its low byte, that byte plus 12, and the high byte plus 24 to the same shared output byte in sequence, leaving the last value stored. The routine returns no value.

name: clear_256_longwords
description: Zeroes 256 consecutive longwords starting at a fixed memory address, counting a 16-bit index down from 255 until it wraps to minus one.

name: lookup_nibble_table_byte
description: Returns the byte from a 16-entry table at the shared global base, indexed by the low four bits of D0.

name: lookup_triple_index_table
description: Multiplies the low byte of D0 by three and returns the table byte at that scaled offset in a constant lookup table.

name: apply_lookup_deltas_to_record
description: XORs the low nibble of a looked-up value into the record byte at offset 15, then adds two register-supplied deltas to the record's bytes at offsets 9 and 10.

name: read_cyclic_byte_sequence
description: Advances the counter byte at the pointer and returns the buffer entry at that index. A zero entry resets the counter to one and returns the first entry instead.

name: advance_fixed_point_accumulator
description: Adds a shifted multi-word fixed-point value into two 16-bit accumulator words with carry, and when the result's top bit is clear it increments the shared byte counter, propagating carry through adjacent bytes.

name: invoke_step_routine_twice
description: Calls the same unnamed subroutine two times in succession and returns, performing no other work.

name: reset_record_marker_bytes
description: Runs the same two subroutines, clears the top bit of a flag byte in the record, and sets the two bytes that follow it to all ones.

name: run_conditional_init_then_sweep
description: Returns early when a preceding check fails; otherwise it writes several shared globals, calls a series of subroutines, and loops over a counter stepping from 80 to 180 in steps of 20, calling a routine each pass.

name: stub_immediate_return
description: Contains only a return instruction, so calling it performs no work.

name: loop_call_while_flag
description: Calls a subroutine and repeats the call while the zero flag passed in was set, forcing that flag to one on each pass. If the flag was clear on entry the call runs once.

name: poll_status_and_dispatch
description: Clears the lowest bit of three shared bytes, reads a status byte, and when that status is not all ones with its low bit set, transfers control through a stored routine pointer. Otherwise it returns the status.

name: set_record_bits_from_flag
description: ORs bit one into the byte at the address register, and also sets bit zero when the zero flag is set.

name: xor_invert_shared_byte_bits
description: Replaces the shared byte with the input byte XORed against the inverted upper seven bits of its previous value, so bit zero of the result equals bit zero of the input.

name: blend_byte_with_conditional_invert
description: Blends the input into the shared byte so bits one to seven keep the old value and bit zero comes from the input, then ORs the input in. If that OR changes the result, it stores the blend inverted in bits one to seven.

name: stub_empty_callback
description: Does nothing but return. It is called from sixteen places and serves as a no-op hook.

name: set_object_position_from_direction
description: Uses a shared direction code to choose a case, writes adjusted offsets from constant tables into the record's position and state bytes, copies them into shared bytes, and returns a status pointer.

name: finish_sprite_state_setup
description: Loads a table entry, copies three bytes from a stack argument into shared bytes, clears a record's 32-bit field and sets two of its bytes to all ones, then calls two subroutines.

name: stub_no_op_global_copy
description: Assigns the shared global byte to itself and returns, so it changes nothing and performs no work.

name: copy_tile_block_if_flagged
description: When a bit in the shared status byte is set and a table-derived value is nonzero, it copies a 12-column by 24-row byte block into a fixed work buffer with a 24-byte row stride, then calls a subroutine and sets a shared global to 64.

name: copy_tile_block_from_input
description: Stores the input byte in a shared global, calls a subroutine, copies the same 12-column by 24-row block into the fixed work buffer, calls another subroutine and sets a shared global to 64.

name: conditional_call_on_negative_flag
description: Returns the constant minus 55 by default. When the shared status byte is negative, it calls a subroutine and returns that call's result instead.

name: gate_status_bit_then_call
description: Returns the input unchanged when bit zero of the shared status byte is clear. When it is set, it calls a subroutine if the byte is negative and then returns the input. The large nested branch is unreachable as decompiled, since its condition requires one byte to be both zero and nonzero.

name: remap_nibbles_into_work_buffer
description: Runs a flag-toggling state check, then either returns early or copies a 12-column by 24-row block into a fixed work buffer, remapping each byte's two 4-bit values through constant substitution values and leaving zero and fourteen unchanged. It then calls a subroutine and sets a shared global to 64.

name: store_index_or_remap_copy
description: When the input is not minus one, stores it in a record field, clears bit one of a flag byte and sets a shared global to 223. When it is minus one, it runs the same remapped block copy into the work buffer as its neighbouring routine.

name: stub_return_without_work
description: Contains only a return instruction, so calling it performs no work. It is called from two places.

name: set_direction_flags_from_status
description: Derives four shared direction flag bytes from the low two bits of the status global, clearing or setting the corresponding bits. When the status equals three, it also sets two additional flag bits.

name: set_record_direction_flags
description: Writes direction flags into a record from the low two bits of the input, setting two record flag bytes to one when the matching input bit is clear. When the input equals three, it also sets two bits in the record's flag bytes.

name: read_shared_status_value
description: Returns the shared global value as its result, with no other work.

name: return_shared_byte_halved
description: Returns the shared global byte shifted right by one bit.

name: call_stored_handler_pointer
description: Stores the address of a routine in a shared pointer, passes that address to a subroutine, restores the saved pointer, runs three subroutines, then calls through the shared pointer.

name: copy_block_then_dispatch_handler
description: Copies a memory block with the shared block copy routine, runs several further subroutines, and finishes by calling through the shared handler pointer.

name: call_shared_handler_pointer
description: Calls the routine whose address is held in the shared handler pointer and returns.

name: copy_24_byte_block_pair
description: Copies a 24-byte block from one buffer into another around a subroutine call, copies the block back, assigns the shared global to itself, and clears four shared bytes spaced four apart.

name: clear_four_shared_slots
description: Clears four shared byte slots spaced four bytes apart and assigns the shared global to itself.

name: stub_return_empty_hook
description: Contains only a return instruction, so calling it has no effect. It is called from two places.

name: dispatch_through_handler_pointer
description: Calls through the shared handler pointer and returns. It is called from three places.

name: swap_byte_ranges
description: Swaps bytes pairwise between two buffers, looping over a count taken from the D1 input down to zero inclusive.

name: endless_loop_with_busy_wait
description: Repeatedly advances a shared global by sixteen, calls several subroutines, and busy-waits in a nested countdown loop of twenty by 65536 steps. The routine never returns.

name: load_palette_bank_from_table
description: Uses the low byte of D0 times 32 as an offset into a constant table and copies eight longwords into colour registers COLOR00 to COLOR07.

name: load_palette_bank_from_global
description: Uses the shared global byte times 32 as an offset into the same constant table and copies eight longwords into colour registers COLOR00 to COLOR07.

name: load_palette_from_word_index
description: Uses the input word shifted left by five bits as an offset into the constant palette table and copies eight longwords into colour registers COLOR00 to COLOR07.

name: compute_offsets_and_release_slot
description: Derives offset values from the low bits of the shared status byte, stores them in shared globals and calls two subroutines. When bit one of the status is clear, it scans a table backwards in two-byte steps for the first nonzero entry and clears it if its flag bits are set.

name: find_first_slot_and_clear
description: Scans a table forward in two-byte steps for the first nonzero entry, then clears that entry and its following byte when the low flag bits of that byte are set.

name: copy_block_forward_by_count
description: Reads a count byte at the pointer and copies that many bytes, starting just after the count, to a position shifted forward by the count.

name: copy_strided_longwords_to_global
description: Calls a subroutine, then copies four longwords from the input buffer into consecutive shared longword slots, advancing the source by eight bytes for each copy.

name: copy_strided_longwords_to_pointer
description: Copies four longwords from the source pointer to the destination pointer, advancing both pointers by eight bytes per step.

name: select_table_entry_by_nibble
description: Stores the input byte in the shared global, then scales the low nibble of the input by eight and stores the resulting table address in shared globals.

name: snapshot_record_position_fields
description: Saves the record's first two longwords into the fields at offsets 24 and 28, subtracts six from the byte at offset 31, and, when a flag bit is clear, copies the byte at offset 8 into offset 32.

name: insert_node_into_linked_list
description: Copies the input bytes into a node buffer, optionally duplicates a fourteen-byte header, walks a linked list to find the insertion point, and splices the new node in by updating its forward and backward links.

name: splice_node_into_linked_list
description: Selects a list start from a shared state value, walks the linked list to the insertion point, and splices the record into the list by updating its forward and backward links. It returns the forward link value.

name: link_node_after_list_walk
description: Calls two subroutines, walks the shared linked list until its end or a matching entry, then links the node at the address register into the list by updating its forward and backward pointers.

name: link_record_into_list
description: Chooses a starting point from a record flag bit, walks the shared linked list to the insertion point, then links the record's four-byte node into the list and returns its forward link.

name: link_node_after_setup_calls
description: Calls two subroutines, walks the shared linked list to the insertion point, and links the node at the address register into it by updating forward and backward pointers.

name: unlink_node_from_list
description: When a flag bit is set, calls a subroutine and steps the node pointer forward by six bytes. It then removes the node from a doubly linked list by joining its neighbours' forward and backward links.

name: unlink_node_with_flag_call
description: When a flag bit is set, calls a subroutine and steps the node pointer forward by six bytes. It then removes the node from a doubly linked list by joining its neighbours' links.

name: unlink_list_node_at_address
description: Removes the node at the address register from a doubly linked list by joining its predecessor and successor. A null link is redirected to the shared list head.

name: test_flag_and_adjust_offset
description: Returns the record's bit-three flag masked from its flag byte. When that bit is set, it subtracts six from the record byte at offset 11.

name: compute_sprite_corner_offsets
description: Reads two position bytes and a size byte from a source record, uses flag bits to choose the sign and spacing of each offset, and writes four corner coordinate bytes plus two derived bytes into a destination record.

name: compare_bounding_boxes_separation
description: Compares two bounding boxes stored as word coordinates along three axes using strict separation tests on each axis pair. It returns 0 or 1 to indicate whether the boxes are separated.

name: initialise_frame_state
description: Sets default shared values, clears sixteen longwords of a table, and calls a set of subroutines depending on bits eleven and ten of a shared word before restoring that word.

name: initialise_frame_state_pointer_variant
description: Resets the same shared values and clears the same sixteen-longword table as its sibling, starting from a pointer reset. It then calls subroutines depending on bits eleven and ten of a shared word.

name: combine_buffers_and_search_table
description: Computes sums and differences from two source buffers, rotates bit patterns across four words, and when a flag is set, searches a table of word entries for a matching key. It returns when no match is found.

name: add_signed_3bit_delta
description: Sign-extends the low three bits of the input, treating bit two as the sign, and returns the byte at the address register plus that signed value.

name: decode_command_stream
description: Reads command bytes from a stream: a byte of 255 ends the command, bytes of 192 or more write a run of three bytes with accumulated offsets into a buffer, and other values set a mode byte before the result is chosen by its low bit.

name: select_status_result_code
description: Calls two subroutines, then returns a result chosen from the shared status byte. A set low bit lets a subroutine supply the value, and otherwise the result is 24, or the result of one more call when the byte is zero.

name: return_default_or_call
description: Returns the constant 24 unless the shared global byte is zero, in which case it calls a subroutine and returns its result.

name: set_entry_coordinates_from_record
description: Sets a shared index to one, derives coordinate globals from a byte in the caller's record, and calls subroutines. A conditional branch that depends on a callee's flag result stores a computed value before returning.

name: shift_bit_into_accumulator
description: Shifts a bit into a shared accumulator word. When the input is greater than one it stores a computed byte at the destination, and when the input equals one it sets bit eight of the accumulator.

name: draw_tile_row_edge_fixup
description: Sets a drawing position from a row value times eight plus 36 and writes the input value. When a flag is set it writes two source bytes at successive offsets, then adjusts the shared byte when its masked bits are zero or all set.

name: draw_tile_row_from_pointer
description: Repeats the same row drawing as its neighbour, writing the input value and, when a flag is set, two bytes read from the source pointer at successive offsets. It then adjusts the shared byte at the edge.

name: fix_edge_bits_and_draw
description: Calls a subroutine, then when the masked bits of the shared byte are zero or all set, rewrites it to its low bit plus one. If that differs from a constant it draws a value offset by six before restoring the byte.

name: find_table_record_by_id
description: Sets the shared global to 128, then walks a length-prefixed record table until it finds an entry whose second byte matches the input value.

name: return_status_or_negated_field
description: Calls a subroutine and returns its result when the shared byte is below sixteen. Otherwise it returns a value derived from the record byte at offset three.

name: or_byte_into_destination
description: Calls a subroutine, then ORs the value in the D5 register into the byte at the destination pointer.

name: search_keyed_table_load_bits
description: Walks a length-prefixed table from a fixed start, comparing the high twelve bits of each entry's key with the input. On a match it loads shifted bit values into the shared state.

name: search_keyed_table_from_pointer
description: Walks a length-prefixed table from the address register, comparing the high twelve bits of each entry's key with the input word. On a match it loads shifted bit values into the shared state.

name: shift_out_bits_from_stream
description: Shifts the shared bit buffer left once per count step. When the buffer empties it reloads from the next input byte with a marker bit set, repeating for the count plus one.

name: toggle_status_bit_four
description: Selects a bit from the shared status byte and toggles bit four to match it. When bit four is then set, it adjusts bit zero if bit one is set and subtracts two from the status.

name: store_pair_after_leading_call
description: Calls a subroutine, then stores two values returned by further subroutine calls into successive destination bytes. It writes a derived byte from the source byte and a register value, then sets the shared byte from a bitwise combination of three registers.

name: store_two_returned_bytes
description: Stores two values returned by subroutine calls into successive destination bytes, writes a derived byte from the source byte and a register value, then sets the shared byte from a bitwise combination of three registers.

name: store_two_returned_bytes_variant
description: Repeats the same two-byte store and derived-byte computation as its neighbour, with the derived value taken from a shifted register. It sets the shared byte from the same bitwise combination.

name: invoke_step_routine_thrice
description: Calls the same unnamed subroutine three times in sequence and returns.

name: build_byte_pair_table
description: Clamps a count derived from two byte inputs, then fills a table with byte pairs in a counted loop. It writes a separator pair each time the inner counter expires and adjusts the final entry.

name: store_halved_sum_and_difference
description: Takes a value returned by a subroutine less six and stores half of its sum and half of its difference with the register input. Each result carries a carry flag in its top bit, and the shared byte is set to the input between the two stores.

name: compute_difference_from_two_bytes
description: Returns seven minus the byte two positions before the pointer, minus the byte one position before it.

name: set_global_from_row_index
description: Sets the shared global byte to the input value multiplied by 192 plus a constant base, keeping the low byte of the result.

name: load_record_state_from_table
description: Clears a record flag byte, loads two state fields from a three-byte table entry selected by the input, and sets further record flag bits from a source byte's pattern. It calls a subroutine on one path and stores a constant in another record field.

name: advance_frame_from_pointer_table
description: Reads a state byte from the record and, when its high bits select a table entry, fetches the next frame value into the record's frame byte and updates the state. Certain state codes call a subroutine and return its result, and other paths return one.

name: set_frame_from_input_byte
description: Stores the input byte as the record's frame value. When the input is 128 or more it shifts it into the state byte and selects the next frame from a pointer table, otherwise it returns the input.

name: advance_frame_state_core
description: Advances the record's frame from its state byte through a pointer table when the high bits are set, storing the frame value and updating the state. For certain state codes it calls a subroutine and returns that result.

name: reset_buffer_and_copy_tables
description: Clears 296 longwords of a buffer and sets shared globals. When the input is nonzero it copies one of two source tables into the buffer in reverse order, choosing the table from a subroutine's result.

name: reset_buffer_copy_tables_alt
description: Clears 296 longwords of a buffer and sets shared globals. When the input is nonzero it copies one of two source tables into the buffer in reverse order, choosing the table from a subroutine's result.

name: copy_reversed_tables_by_selector
description: Chooses one of two source tables depending on whether the input equals six, copies the chosen table backwards into the destination in a counted loop, and returns the input minus six.

name: copy_reversed_sixteen_entries
description: Copies sixteen longword entries backwards from two fixed source tables into the destination pointer.

name: build_column_byte_pairs
description: When a status bit is clear, it clears the shared byte and fills a table backwards with byte pairs derived from a computed step. A separator pair is written each time the inner counter expires, similar to its sibling routine.

name: swap_longword_halves
description: Calls a subroutine and returns its 32-bit result with the upper and lower words exchanged.

name: set_object_offsets_from_code
description: Sets shared status values from the input, selects offset values from a small code and writes three record offset bytes, then copies them into shared bytes and returns a pointer. For code six it returns minus 56 unless the status is negative.

name: wait_then_set_masked_flag
description: Calls a subroutine repeatedly while the shared status byte is nonzero, then stores the high byte of its stack argument XOR three with bit two set from bit zero.

name: wait_status_then_set_flag
description: Calls a subroutine while the shared status byte is nonzero, then stores the high byte of its stack argument XOR three with bit two set from bit zero.

name: copy_fixed_palette_bank
description: Calls a subroutine, then copies eight longwords from a fixed table into colour registers COLOR00 to COLOR07.

name: copy_remapped_blocks_from_list
description: Runs a fixed sequence of subroutine calls, then loops over a list of records. For each record it either copies a 12-by-24 byte block into the work buffer with nibble remapping or skips it, and finishes by setting a shared global to 64.

name: remap_block_after_state_check
description: Performs a conditional state update and a set of subroutine calls, then loops over a list of records, copying each selected 12-by-24 byte block into the work buffer with nibble remapping. It finishes by setting a shared global to 64.

name: remap_block_from_setup_calls
description: Makes three setup calls, then loops over a list of records, copying each selected 12-by-24 byte block into the work buffer with nibble remapping. It finishes by setting a shared global to 64.

name: compute_flags_then_release_slot
description: Derives a state code from comparing two record coordinate bytes and stores shared offsets from the status bits, calling subroutines along the way. When bit one of the original status is clear, it scans a table backwards in two-byte steps for the first nonzero entry and clears it if its flag bits are set.

name: set_status_bit_from_input
description: Clears bit two of the shared status byte and sets it from bit zero of the input byte.

name: clear_ten_longwords
description: Zeroes ten consecutive longwords starting at a fixed memory address.

name: count_set_bits_in_table
description: Counts the one bits across ten consecutive longwords starting at a fixed address and returns the total.

name: count_masked_status_bits
description: Counts the set bits in the shared status byte with bit two cleared and returns the count.

name: count_status_set_bits
description: Counts the set bits in the shared status byte, including bit two, and returns the count.

name: select_and_reduce_decimal_value
description: Starts from zero, 501 or 1000 depending on a flag bit and the shared status byte, then reduces it modulo successive powers of ten. The result is below ten.

name: reduce_value_to_decimal_digit
description: Returns the input reduced modulo ten by successive division steps using the powers of ten from 1000 down to 1.

name: multiply_low_words
description: Returns the product of the low word of the first input and the low word of the second input.

name: call_routine_over_grid
description: Makes one initial subroutine call, then calls a subroutine at each point of a grid. Rows start at 87 and step by 42, and columns start at 64 and step by 24.

name: store_masked_adjusted_word
description: Stores the input word with its low byte increased by three into the shared word, clearing the two lowest bits of each byte.

name: clamp_and_process_list_entries
description: Checks the input bytes against range limits and, when they pass, adjusts a value and calls subroutines. It then walks a linked list at a fixed head, calling a routine with 214 for each entry.

name: clamp_walk_list_single_call
description: Makes one setup call, then checks the input bytes against range limits and adjusts a value when they pass. It then calls a subroutine and walks a linked list at a fixed head, calling a routine with 214 for each entry.

name: clamp_and_walk_list_core
description: Checks the input bytes against range limits and adjusts a value when they pass. It then calls a subroutine and walks a linked list at a fixed head, calling a routine with 214 for each entry.

name: walk_list_calling_each_node
description: Walks a linked list from the address register, storing each node in the shared global and calling a subroutine for it, until a null link ends the list.

name: blit_masked_sprite_rows
description: Blends a sprite into a bitplane buffer row by row, writing each byte as the first source OR-ed with the second source AND-ed against the existing destination byte. Destination rows are 24 bytes apart.

name: convert_chunky_pixels_to_bitplanes
description: Converts four chunky source bytes per step into four bitplane bytes by looking up per-plane bit patterns in tables and OR-ing them. Each plane is written to a separate buffer region spaced 8000 bytes apart.

name: draw_clipped_horizontal_span
description: Clips a horizontal span against width limits of 56 or 74 depending on a flag bit. It then writes table-sourced longwords, or zeroes, into the destination at a stride of 24 bytes per row.

name: return_byte_after_call
description: Calls a subroutine and returns the input byte unchanged.

name: dispatch_clipped_span_draw
description: Clips a span against the same width limits, then dispatches to one of several fill handlers through stored pointers based on the clipped length. An empty span returns early.

name: dispatch_span_handler_a
description: Calls the span handler stored in one dispatch slot and returns.

name: dispatch_span_handler_b
description: Calls the span handler stored in a second dispatch slot and returns.

name: invoke_single_setup_call
description: Calls one subroutine, passing no data, and returns.

name: dispatch_span_handler_c
description: Calls the span handler stored in a third dispatch slot and returns.

name: dispatch_span_handler_d
description: Calls the span handler stored in a fourth dispatch slot and returns.

name: clear_buffer_or_dispatch
description: When bit two of the input is clear, it returns the result of a subroutine call. Otherwise it either calls a subroutine when the shared status is zero, or clears 296 longwords and returns minus one when the status is nonzero.

name: stub_return_no_effect
description: Contains only a return instruction and performs no work.

name: clear_strided_longwords
description: Zeroes one longword per row of a table and advances the destination by 24 bytes each step, repeating for the number of times given by the D7 input.

name: clear_strided_longword_pairs
description: Zeroes two consecutive longwords per row of a table and advances the destination by 24 bytes each step, repeating for the number of times given by the D7 input.

name: copy_strided_longwords_to_rows
description: Copies one longword per row from a source offset by four bytes, advancing the source by eight bytes and the destination by 24 bytes per step.

name: copy_longwords_to_rows_base
description: Copies one longword per row from a source starting at its base, advancing the source by eight bytes and the destination by 24 bytes per step.

name: copy_longword_pairs_to_rows
description: Copies two consecutive longwords per step from the source into each destination row, advancing the source by eight bytes and the destination by 24 bytes.

name: fill_rows_from_cyclic_table
description: Selects a table base from the sign of a source byte and calls a subroutine. It then fills destination rows with two longwords read from a cyclic table indexed by the low nibble of the second input, advancing 24 bytes per row.

name: copy_rows_from_cyclic_table
description: Copies two longwords per row from a cyclic table into the destination. The table index advances by eight bytes with wrap-around, and the destination advances 24 bytes per row.

name: fill_rows_from_cyclic_longwords
description: Chooses one of two table offsets from the sign of a source byte and calls a subroutine. It then writes one longword per row from a cyclic table into the destination, advancing 24 bytes per row.

name: fill_rows_cyclic_longwords_alt
description: Chooses table base zero or 64 from the sign of a source byte and calls a subroutine. It then writes one longword per row from a cyclic table indexed by the low nibble of the second input, advancing 24 bytes per row.

name: copy_cyclic_longwords_to_rows
description: Writes one longword per row from a cyclic table into the destination. The table index advances by eight bytes with wrap-around, and the destination advances 24 bytes per row.

name: test_bits_zero_two
description: Checks whether bits zero and two of the byte at the address register are both set, then returns without changing anything either way.

name: stub_return_no_work_b
description: Contains only a return instruction and performs no work.

name: return_word_after_call
description: Calls a subroutine, then returns the input word unchanged.

name: store_call_result_and_registers
description: Stores the result of a subroutine call into the shared global, then writes three register input bytes to it in turn, leaving the last input value stored.

name: return_clamped_byte_pair
description: Calls a subroutine, then returns a word whose high byte is the smaller of the shared byte and the D2 input and whose low byte is the larger of the shared byte and the D5 input.

name: store_masked_adjusted_word_alt
description: Stores the input word with its low byte increased by three into the shared word, clearing the two lowest bits of each byte.

name: copy_mask_tables_clear_columns
description: Copies 336 longwords from a source into two table regions, then clears and sets bytes of mask columns in a bitplane pair for a row count derived from the input. The mask shifts by one byte on each row.

name: compute_frame_buffer_offset
description: Maps a frame code in the shared global, masked to seven bits, to a buffer offset using piecewise scaling by constants 768, 576 and 896. Extra adjustments depend on flag bits, and the offset is returned.

name: stub_return_no_work_c
description: Contains only a return instruction and performs no work.

name: swap_word_halves_of_pair
description: Calls subroutines to obtain two longwords, returning them with the upper and lower words of each exchanged. A conditional byte-difference update is gated by a constant zero flag and never runs as decompiled.

name: stub_return_no_work_d
description: Contains only a return instruction and performs no work.

name: compute_sprite_step_offset
description: Combines a record's flag byte with the low byte of a subroutine result, then returns a step of four to eight added to the input. The step depends on the magnitude of the combined value and the record's flag bits.

name: compute_sprite_step_offset_alt
description: Combines a record's flag byte with the low byte of a subroutine result, then returns a step of four to eight added to the input. The step depends on the magnitude of the combined value and the record's flag bits.

name: compute_sprite_step_offset_gated
description: When bit three of the record's flag byte is set it returns a subroutine's result. Otherwise it computes a step offset from the record's flag byte and a subroutine result, then adds the input.

name: stub_return_no_work_e
description: Contains only a return instruction and performs no work.

name: clear_nibble_in_fifty_longwords
description: Clears one nibble, bits 16 to 19, in each of fifty consecutive longwords starting at a shared address.

name: search_word_table_after_setup
description: When the zero flag is set, it stores a subroutine result and sets two shared globals to 96 and 26, with the first set to zero when the stored value is 14. It then makes three calls and scans a word table for the input value over the count in D2.

name: return_low_nibble_at_offset
description: Returns the low four bits of the byte at offset three in the record.

name: search_global_table_for_byte
description: Scans fifty-two word entries starting at the shared global for the value of the shared byte, returning as soon as a match is found.

name: search_global_table_for_word
description: Scans fifty-two word entries starting at the shared global for the input word, returning as soon as a match is found.

name: dispatch_object_state_by_nibble
description: Compares the low nibble of a record byte with a supplied value and scans a word table on mismatch. On a match it sets a record flag and switches on the nibble to run one of several effect handlers that call subroutines and update shared globals. The switch case fourteen decodes as bad data and is not a real handler.

name: return_default_or_call_negative
description: Returns the constant minus 59 by default. When the shared status byte is negative, it calls a subroutine and returns that result instead.

name: run_fixed_call_sequence
description: Makes a fixed sequence of subroutine calls, passing the constant 24 to two of them, and returns minus one. A preliminary call is made only when the shared byte equals three.

name: run_fixed_call_sequence_short
description: Makes a shorter fixed sequence of subroutine calls, passing the constant 24 to two of them, and returns minus one.

name: invoke_four_calls_minus_one
description: Makes four subroutine calls in sequence and returns minus one.

name: pack_status_bits_copy_tag
description: Packs the low bit of each of six shared words into a byte, increments the shared byte, and copies a short tag into the output. The tag comes from one of two sources chosen by the value.

name: copy_four_bytes_fill_four
description: Copies four shared bytes to the destination, then writes the shared byte into the four bytes that follow the copy.

name: unpack_header_and_bit_stream
description: Decrements a shared counter, unpacks header fields from the source into shared globals, and expands a bit stream into a buffer of words. It then copies per-record fields into shared bytes and calls subroutines.

name: read_bits_then_unpack_header
description: Shifts bits from an input bit stream into a buffer of words for a counted number of steps, then copies header fields into shared bytes. It calls subroutines and resets two shared globals to eight.

name: return_scaled_global_plus_one
description: Returns the shared global byte plus one, multiplied by 23.

name: or_rotating_bit_run_mask
description: ORs into the byte at the address register a mask of bits formed by rotating a run of set bits by the input plus one, so the run wraps around the byte.

name: return_result_or_minus_one
description: Calls a subroutine and returns its result when the zero flag is set. When the zero flag is clear, it makes another call and returns minus one.

name: run_seven_call_pairs
description: Makes one subroutine call, then makes seven pairs of subroutine calls.

name: add_bcd_digit_to_byte
description: Adds the input value to the byte at the address register using decimal-coded arithmetic and stores the result back in that byte.

name: decrement_bcd_byte_if_nonzero
description: When the byte at the address register is nonzero, it decrements that byte using decimal-coded arithmetic and returns minus one. Otherwise it returns zero.

name: lookup_table_byte_unless_flagged
description: Returns the table byte at the index given by the low byte of the input, or the constant 3 when the shared global byte is nonzero.

name: store_input_and_return_global
description: Calls a subroutine, stores the input byte in the shared global, calls another subroutine, and returns the global value.

name: load_global_from_record
description: Loads the shared global byte from the first word of the ten-byte record selected by the low byte of the input.

name: find_entry_mask_flags
description: Walks a linked list calling a handler for each entry until the handler reports a match. On a match it ANDs the shared global into one flag byte of that entry and returns minus one. Otherwise it walks a second list and conditionally calls a handler.

name: find_list_entry_mask_flags
description: Walks a linked list calling a handler for each entry until it reports a match. On a match it ANDs the shared global into one flag byte of that entry and returns minus one, otherwise it calls a follow-up routine and returns a result.

name: conditional_handler_call_on_flag
description: Calls a subroutine, then when a record flag bit is clear or the register pair differs, calls the stored handler and returns its result if that handler reports success.

name: mask_record_flag_with_global
description: ANDs the shared global byte into one of two record flag bytes, chosen by bit one of the record's flag byte. It then calls a subroutine and returns minus one.

name: and_input_into_record_flag
description: ANDs the input byte into the record byte at offset 16, calls a subroutine, and returns minus one.

name: dispatch_object_state_variant
description: Checks record flag bits and a shared value, then either scans a word table or sets record state and switches on a low nibble to run effect handlers that call subroutines and update shared globals. The listing is cut off inside the final case, so that case's behaviour cannot be recovered.

name: compute_status_code_from_flags
description: Derives a small status code from two flag bits of its inputs and ORs it into the shared status byte. It returns either a fixed value of 31 or minus 58, or the result of a subroutine call, depending on the resulting state.

name: update_entity_link_and_flags
description: Compares a record's byte at offset eleven with the input and, when they differ, walks a linked list of entries to find one in the matching position band. It updates the record's link and flag bytes, returning minus one when a matching entry is handled and zero otherwise.

name: stub_empty_decompile_listing
description: The decompiler produced only a return for this routine, which has 154 instructions, so its behaviour cannot be recovered from the supplied evidence.

name: offset_record_position_and_scan
description: Calls a subroutine, sets two record coordinate bytes six and seven above a base value, then walks a linked list and calls a subroutine for each flagged entry whose coordinates match.

name: scan_entries_for_collision_row
description: Sets a record coordinate byte from its neighbour minus one, then walks a linked list of entries comparing coordinate bytes and calling a subroutine on matches. It finishes by clearing flag bits and calling a handler.

name: compare_input_with_record_coordinate
description: Compares the input byte with the record's byte at offset nine. When they match and the shared global is zero, it calls subroutines and returns minus one, otherwise it returns the shared global.

name: invoke_single_call_return
description: Calls a subroutine and returns.

name: return_overlap_attribute_byte
description: Calls a subroutine, then compares four byte fields of two records. When the records overlap on those fields it returns the second record's byte at offset seven, otherwise it returns a byte from the first record.

name: return_overlap_attribute_byte_direct
description: Performs the same overlap comparison of record fields as its neighbour, without the leading subroutine call. It returns the second record's byte at offset seven when the records overlap.

name: compute_record_edge_coordinates
description: Computes four edge coordinate bytes for a record from its position bytes and a step of three or four chosen by a flag bit. It writes them into the destination record at offsets plus and minus the step.

name: map_index_through_range_checks
description: Maps the low byte of the input through a series of range checks that subtract fixed offsets, falling back to fixed values above a threshold. It returns a scaled result.

name: process_state_loop_result
description: Runs a loop of subroutine calls and reads a shared status value that selects one of several branches. Each branch updates the shared global with a flag bit or a table entry and returns a value derived from it.

name: return_minus_61_or_call
description: Returns the input unchanged unless the shared byte equals minus one. In that case it returns minus 61, or the result of a subroutine call when the byte is negative.

name: copy_remapped_block_from_triples
description: Loops over a table of three-byte records. For each record whose flag bit is clear it copies a 12-by-24 byte block into the work buffer with nibble remapping, shifting the flag word right each step. It finishes by setting a shared global to 64.
